per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  u1.name AS university_name,
  COUNT(c1.campus_id) AS campus_count
FROM 
  universities u1
JOIN 
  professors p ON p.university_id = u1.university_id
JOIN 
  campuses c1 ON c1.university_id = u1.university_id
WHERE 
  p.name = 'Richard J. Wood'
  AND u1.state = 'CT'
GROUP BY 
  u1.name;

SELECT 
  u2.name AS university_name,
  COUNT(c2.campus_id) AS campus_count
FROM 
  universities u2
JOIN 
  campuses c2 ON c2.university_id = u2.university_id
WHERE 
  u2.name = 'California State Polytechnic University, Pomona'
GROUP BY 
  u2.name;
